scripts.dev: npm run build -w @abapro/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @abapro/api" "npm run dev -w @abapro/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @abapro/shared && npm run build -w @abapro/api && npm run build -w @abapro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @abapro/shared && npm run typecheck -w @abapro/api && npm run typecheck -w @abapro/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @abapro/api && npm run lint -w @abapro/web && npm run lint -w @abapro/shared
